data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'erion', meaning mountain, and 'ha', meaning flower. Eriha represents the beauty and strength found in nature. The name Eriha carries the meaning “Mountain flower” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eriha usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of connection to the earth and divine grace.
data.etymology: Eriha belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain flower.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eriha total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
data.cultural_impact: The name Eriha is not a commonly used Christian name, and it brings a unique and exotic feel to the table. Its origin from Greek culture adds a historical and diverse quality to the name. When someone meets a child or an individual named Eriha, it immediately sparks curiosity and intrigue, making it an excellent conversation starter.
data.spiritual_significance: Eriha's name implies the strength and beauty found in nature and can serve as a reminder of the divine presence in our lives. It can be seen as a reminder to appreciate and cherish the world around us, as well as the innate beauty within ourselves. In a spiritual sense, Eriha represents the harmonious balance between the earthly and divine, and can inspire a deeper connection with nature and the Creator.
